summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 43 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: ‘Not healthy’ LLM use is more common than you think
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Device Code Phishing Up 1,500% in 2026; Vishing Doubles
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 44 articles published in the last 24 hours
